title: Work and Energy
summary: Work transfers energy; kinetic and potential energy trade off in a closed system.

outline.heading: Work
points: Work is the force times the distance moved along it.
Work done changes the energy of an object.

outline.heading: Conservation
points: Without friction, mechanical energy is conserved.
Friction turns some energy into heat.

assignments.task: Solve problems one to six on the worksheet

questions: Where does the energy go when a ball stops bouncing?
